name: Perimeter and area of rectilinear shapes
definition: Perimeter is the distance all the way round; area is how much surface is covered. For shapes made of rectangles you can cut the shape into rectangles, or count squares. The two are independent: two shapes with the same area can have very different perimeters.
recognizeWhen: find the perimeter of this L-shaped figure
how many squares does the shape cover
the shape is made of unit squares
which of these shapes has the largest area
misconceptions: I mixed up perimeter and area because both are just numbers about the shape.
I forgot to include the sides whose lengths were not written on the diagram.
I assumed a bigger perimeter meant a bigger area.
